title: Loyalty, referrals and your 90-day customer plan

say: Loyalty, referrals and your 90-day customer plan.
This is the video for module 4 of Customer Relations and Sales.
Most of the hard work in sales happens before the first purchase. Once a customer has bought and been happy, selling to her again is much easier.

items: A happy buyer is easier to sell to again

say: In this video you will plan follow-ups, a loyalty reward, referrals, and a 90-day plan.

items: A happy buyer is easier to sell to again

say: Day 0, say thank you. Thank you for your order, Ada. It was a pleasure serving you.

panel.heading: A follow-up after every sale
items: Before she runs out: reorder reminder
Special dates: a short personal greeting

say: Day 2, check satisfaction. I hope the shea butter is working well for you. This catches problems early, when they are easy to fix.

panel.heading: A follow-up after every sale
items: Before she runs out: reorder reminder
Special dates: a short personal greeting

say: Then a reorder reminder, timed for just before she runs out. Ask customers how long the product lasted, note it, and put the next follow-up date in your list.

panel.heading: A follow-up after every sale
items: Before she runs out: reorder reminder
Special dates: a short personal greeting

say: Now and then, a festive greeting, kept personal and brief.

panel.heading: A follow-up after every sale
items: Before she runs out: reorder reminder
Special dates: a short personal greeting

say: Do not overdo messages. Too many promotions make customers mute or block you, and never add people to groups without asking.

panel.heading: A follow-up after every sale
items: Before she runs out: reorder reminder
Special dates: a short personal greeting
panel.rule: Each message has a purpose. None is a hard sales push.

say: Always cost a loyalty reward before you offer it. Ngozi's average order is about 1,200 naira, and one serving costs her about 700. She considers: buy 9 breakfasts, get the 10th free.
9 paid breakfasts bring 10,800 naira. 10 breakfasts cost her 7,000.
So her profit is 3,800 naira, compared with 5,000 for 10 paid ones.
Each completed card costs her about 1,200 naira of profit. She decides it is worth it if customers choose her stall over the one across the road, and she will review it after 2 months.
Ask for a referral right after she shows she is happy. Halima's customer sent a wedding photo: everybody asked who sewed my gown!

panel.heading: The referral moment
items: Make sharing easy: a message to forward

say: Halima thanked her, and asked permission before sharing the photo.

panel.heading: The referral moment
items: Make sharing easy: a message to forward

say: Then she asked a specific question: if any of the ladies would like an outfit, I would be happy to help.

panel.heading: The referral moment
items: Make sharing easy: a message to forward

say: She made it easy, with a short message to forward: her value statement and how to order.

panel.heading: The referral moment
items: Make sharing easy: a message to forward

say: When a new customer mentioned the referrer, Halima thanked her with a small discount on her next order.

panel.heading: The referral moment
items: Make sharing easy: a message to forward

say: Keep thank-yous modest. Schemes built on recruiting people rather than real sales can be pyramid schemes, which harm the people who join late.

panel.heading: The referral moment
items: Make sharing easy: a message to forward
panel.rule: Thank referrers modestly. Avoid schemes built on recruiting.

say: Real customer words are powerful, so collect them honestly. Ask permission before posting any message or photo. Hide phone numbers, and names or faces if she prefers. Never edit her meaning. And prefer specific praise, like the gown was ready two days early.

panel.heading: Testimonials done right
items: Hide phone numbers, and names if she prefers
Prefer specific praise over vague praise

say: Finally, your 90-day plan. Record your starting numbers from last month: customers, repeat customers, follow-up rate and referrals.
Choose one relationship habit, written as a clear action. For example, Grace in Abuja follows up with every customer within 2 days of delivery, using a daily 6pm reminder.
Choose one sales skill. Grace asks three open questions before recommending.
Set targets from your own numbers. Grace aims to move repeat customers from 12 of 25 to at least 15 of 25.
Check monthly. If you miss a week, do not abandon the plan. Restart the next day.
To remember. Follow up after every sale. Cost any reward before offering it. Ask for referrals at the happy moment, and get permission for every testimonial.
One habit kept for 90 days changes a business more than ten ideas abandoned after a week.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Cost any reward before you offer it
Ask for referrals when she is happy
One habit and one skill for 90 days

say: Your turn. Save your four follow-up messages. Cost one loyalty reward with the stamp card method. Write your value statement and a message to forward. Then write your 90-day plan and gather your capstone evidence, with phone numbers hidden.
